games.name: Typical Colors 2
games.desc:
Dive into intense battles with over 200 unique weapons at your disposal!
Play as an offensive, defensive, or support role to push your team to victory.
This game is heavily inspired by Team Fortress 2.

Mobile Players: iOS devices are known to run much better than Android, if you have an android phone, make sure you have at least 6+ gb of Ram.

NOTICE: If you're noticing any frame drops, reduce your graphics quality and mess around with the game's settings [Main Menu > Settings (Top Right) > Graphics] (The game disables some visual features for better frames).

Basic Keyboard and Mouse Bindings:
M  -  Main Menu
W  -  Walk Forward
S  -  Walk Backward
A  -  Walk Left
D  -  Walk Right
Space  -  Jump
Ctrl  -  Crouch
Q  -  Previous Weapon
E  - Call for Doctor
Tab - Show Scoreboard
Numbers keys 1,2,3,4,5 - Select weapon
Scroll Wheel - Select weapons
Left Mouse Button  -  Primary Fire
Right Mouse Button -  Secondary Fire
Y or / - Open All chat
U - Open Team Chat

games.name: Sonic.EXE: The Disaster Eclipsed v1.4
games.desc:
Sonic.EXE: The Disaster Eclipsed v1.42

Sonic.EXE: The Disaster Eclipsed is a recreation of its predecessor [Sonic.EXE: The Disaster by Outlaik], with new survivors, new executioners and new abilities. 
Defend yourself as a survivor against the executioner with up to 6 friends, working together to survive until those who remain can escape. Or slaughter the opposing survivors as the executioner to prevent them from escaping.

Updated character info and a full changelog can be found to the left and back in the lobby.
Clunky gameplay and bugs may still be present, I'm still fixing it all as I go.
Bugfixes and additions to the game might be made, but more than one addition being made at a time is unlikely.
[This game may contain loud sounds and music]

A big thanks to the TD:Reborn team for the original game code, and to Outlaik for creating the original Sonic.EXE: The Disaster!
